Accounts & Identity Authority
Account · profile · verified contacts · auth methods · MFA/passkeys · recovery · Account state

Tunner Session Authority
session_id · device_id · assurance · expiry · revocation

Internal Access
separate workforce identity · roles/scopes · privileged sessions
Tunner Session is central SSO authority, not a shared Product session cookie
Create Tunner Session: session_id, Account, auth methods, assurance, auth time, expiry and client/origin context
Validate session state, expiry, Account restrictions, assurance, revocation and required step-up
Product-local sessions are outside the Tunner Session registry
Mark Tunner session revoked immediately and idempotently
Future Tunner requests using revoked session are denied
Product-local session may remain until Product policy/expiry; Tunner cannot directly mutate it
Product-local session behavior remains Product-owned and must never be assumed by Tunner UI

scope: Bounded canonical readback only; owner session/identity/workforce semantics remain in FRD17/28. Not a new authority or full flow implementation.
